smartSearch.title: Smart Search
smartSearch.placeholder: Enter your research topic, question, or keywords...
smartSearch.wosRequired: Please import WoS journal list first
smartSearch.progress: Round {round}: {included} relevant WoS papers found ({scanned} scanned)
smartSearch.venueFilterHelp: Auto applies the journal-level Web of Science filter only when a journal list has been imported; On requires it; Off sends every record to LLM screening.
smartSearch.venueFilterInactive: Venue filter inactive: no Web of Science journal list imported (Stage 1 skipped)
smartSearch.venueFilterDisabled: Venue filter off: every record went to LLM screening (Stage 1 skipped)
smartSearch.screeningRecordHelp: Record counts at each screening stage. The CSV lists every included, flagged-for-review, excluded and unscreened record with its status, criterion, quote and reason.
smartSearch.downloadFailed: Could not download the screening record
smartSearch.screeningStopSettings: Stop rule: at least {minRounds} rounds, then stop after {patience} rounds in a row with no new inclusions.

stopReasons.screening_failed: Stopped: a screening batch failed; see unscreened records
stopReasons.retrieval_failed: Stopped: retrieval failed for every query (provider down or over quota); see the task message

smartSearch.fullTextOnlyHelp: Mark a criterion "Needs full text" when a title and abstract cannot settle it. A marked exclusion criterion flags a record for review instead of excluding it; a marked inclusion criterion is deferred and listed under "to confirm at full text" on an included record.
smartSearch.toConfirmHelp: Included on the criteria a title and abstract can decide. These need the full paper before the record is final.

needsReviewReasons.full_text_criterion: This criterion needs the full text to decide
needsReviewReasons.cut_abstract: The shown abstract was cut and this criterion tests something not being present
needsReviewReasons.unanchored_exclude: The model's exclusion was not anchored to a shown criterion and quote
needsReviewReasons.unquoted_criterion: Named a criterion without quoting the text it turns on
needsReviewReasons.undecidable: The shown title and abstract could not decide this record

smartSearch.needsReviewHelp: The screener could not decide these from the shown title and abstract. Read them and add the ones that qualify.

accountSettings.expertiseLevelHelp: Set your academic experience level. The AI assistant will adjust the depth of writing guidance and use of technical terminology accordingly.
accountSettings.expertiseHintStudent: Student mode: AI provides detailed step-by-step writing guidance, methodology explanations, and academic convention reminders to help you systematically complete your research paper.
accountSettings.expertiseHintResearcher: Researcher mode: AI provides concise suggestions and advanced analysis tools, assuming familiarity with standard research methods and academic writing conventions.
accountSettings.expertiseHintFaculty: Faculty mode: AI engages as a peer collaborator, focusing on argumentation depth, novelty, and positioning within the field, with minimal basic guidance.
